segment_stretch.note: min/max segment length / rest, all cables, every sim step

no_cable_interpenetration_mm.note: min surface gap over all recorded frames (negative = overlap); IPC keeps it >= 0, al-ipc may dip

below_table_mm.note: min over frames and cables of (lowest centreline z - table top - radius)

cables_on_table.note: max overhang past the table edge, mm (<= 0: on the table)

pile_not_in_bins.note: cables with any vertex inside a bin after the drop

settled_vmax.note: m/s, last 5 frames of the settle

settled_ke.note: J, last 5 frames of the settle

rest_shape_retention.note: per cable 1 - RMSD(settled, rest)/RMSD(straight, rest), best rigid alignment; 1 = rest shape, 0 = straight

pile_curvature_kept.note: per cable sum |turning angle| in the pile / rest: none straightened. One-sided: the softest leads drape over thicker cables and pick up extra curvature (loading, not loss of shape); the two-sided test is rest_shape_isolated

rest_shape_isolated.note: each cable dropped 3 cm alone onto the floor, 4 s (tests/rest_shape_test.py)

rest_shape_control_plain_rod.note: same cables as plain Genesis FEM.Rod (libuipc KRB, straight rest shape): they straighten

tangle_contacts.note: segment pairs of different cables within 2 mm

tangle_interlocked.note: pairs crossing both over and under each other; cables lying over one cable and under another

no_frozen_cable.note: longest run of bit-identical frames of a cable in mid-air

bins_not_in_table.note: min bin bottom height above the table, mm

pads_above_table_mm.note: lowest fingertip mesh point over the table top, all frames

plugs_above_table_mm.note: lowest plug mesh point over the table top, all frames (drawn shell / pin included)

timing.note: sim s, wall s per phase

export_pose_matches_genesis.note: bin mesh x exported pose vs Genesis's own link vertices after step 1, mm (Genesis trails libuipc ~1 step)
